source(output(
		JobGroupID as integer,
		JobGroupName as string,
		EventID as integer,
		EventName as string,
		EventTypeID as integer,
		EventType as string,
		TriggerID as integer,
		Trigger as string,
		Staged as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT 	[JobGroupID], 	[JobGroupName], 	[EventID], 	[EventName], 	[EventTypeID], 	[EventType], 	[TriggerID], 	[Trigger], 	[Staged] FROM [Tidal].[Tidal_JobGroupEvent] WHERE Staged = 0',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ERDBTidalJobGroupEvent	source(output(
		JobGroupId as integer,
		EventID as integer,
		EventTypeID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT        J.jobmst_id AS JobGroupId, TRG.trgmst_id AS EventID, TJ.trgjob_type AS EventTypeID FROM            jobmst AS J INNER JOIN                          jobcls AS CLS ON CLS.jobcls_id = J.jobcls_id AND CLS.jobcls_name IN                              (SELECT        JobClassName                                FROM            ##JobCLassFilter) INNER JOIN                          trgjob AS TJ ON TJ.jobmst_id = J.jobmst_id INNER JOIN                          trgmst AS TRG ON TRG.trgmst_id = TJ.trgmst_id WHERE        (J.jobmst_type = 1) AND (J.jobmst_prntname NOT LIKE \'%wastebasket%\') AND (J.jobmst_dirty <> \'X\')',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupAdmiraltrgmstLKPTABLE
ERDBTidalJobGroupEvent,LookupAdmiraltrgmstLKPTABLE lookup(ERDBTidalJobGroupEvent@JobGroupID == LookupAdmiraltrgmstLKPTABLE@JobGroupId && ERDBTidalJobGroupEvent@EventID == LookupAdmiraltrgmstLKPTABLE@EventID && ERDBTidalJobGroupEvent@EventTypeID == LookupAdmiraltrgmstLKPTABLE@EventTypeID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupAdmiraltrgmst
LookupAdmiraltrgmst select(mapColumn(
		JobGroupID = ERDBTidalJobGroupEvent@JobGroupID,
		JobGroupName = JobGroupName,
		EventID = ERDBTidalJobGroupEvent@EventID,
		EventName = EventName,
		EventTypeID = ERDBTidalJobGroupEvent@EventTypeID,
		EventType = EventType,
		TriggerID = TriggerID,
		Trigger = Trigger,
		Staged = Staged,
		JobGroupId = ERDBTidalJobGroupEvent@JobGroupID
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupAdmiraltrgmstSelect
LookupAdmiraltrgmstSelect filter(!isMatch()) ~> FilterLookupAdmiraltrgmst
